PACKAGE 01

Organic Growth

One package covering websites, funnels, blogs, socials, SEO, directory listings and earned backlinks.

Discuss this option ↗
Setup A$4,950+
  • Up to five core website pages, one offer landing page and one confirmation/next-step page: seven pages total, plus a blog section/template.
  • Mobile and desktop layouts, agreed copy and clear enquiry/booking links.
  • One enquiry form or booking route to one destination, including one existing CRM connection where a supported native connector is suitable. Building a new CRM or custom API is separate.
  • Initial technical SEO, titles, descriptions, internal links and sitemap checks.
  • Review and optimise one eligible Google Business Profile, using approved business details and existing access; verification disputes, reinstatement and additional locations are separate.
  • Record baseline website/search/enquiry measures where data is available, with an agreed acceptance checklist and written handover.
  • Analytics, Search Console and basic enquiry-event setup for one site.
  • Setup or alignment of two social profiles and a consistent business identity pack.
  • Up to five suitable free directory submissions, subject to eligibility and your privacy preferences.
  • One planning call, one handover session and two consolidated build/copy revision rounds.

Before setup is accepted, the written scope will specify page-copy word limits, training duration and the minimum text, images, footage and access you supply. These limits will be confirmed in your written scope.

Existing suitable assets can be retained and the quote adjusted to avoid duplicate work. Ecommerce, custom applications, logo design, paid directories and additional pages are separate.

Monthly A$1,980+
DeliverableMonthly allowance

Social contentEight unique items total: six static/carousel items and two short videos
Social distributionAdapt those eight items for two agreed platforms, up to 16 placements

The six graphics and two videos make up the eight unique social items; they are not additional items. One consolidated revision round is included per monthly content batch. Publishing and external contact for link opportunities require agreed approvals. If suitable listing/link opportunities are unavailable, we report that and propose another organic task for approval.

AI may assist drafting and asset preparation, with human review. Filming, actors, custom animation, voice cloning, VSL production, daily community engagement and inbox replies are excluded. We do not buy ranking links or submit to directories in bulk.

Extra costs: domains, hosting, mailboxes, paid listings, licensed assets and any separately agreed production or integration work. Provider and usage charges are not included.

Status: preparing. Our own website, two agency articles, social profiles and basic SEO foundations are present. Combined delivery, production capacity, mobile usability, enquiry routing, attribution and reporting still need testing. No completed client marketing results are claimed.

PACKAGE 02

Paid Advertising

Start with one offer, one platform and a controlled test.

Discuss this option ↗
Setup A$880+
  • One platform, one offer, one service area and one campaign.
  • Up to three search ad groups or two Meta ad sets, or an equivalent structure agreed for another platform after capability is verified.
  • Up to six ad-copy variants.
  • For visual campaigns, two static image concepts and one video adaptation up to 30 seconds using supplied/approved assets.
  • Existing landing-page review, one primary conversion setup/test where supported, source tracking and an agreed budget/pause plan.

New landing pages, filming, VSL production and custom/server-side tracking are separately scoped. Record the available conversion baseline and agreed campaign acceptance checks before launch.

Monthly A$770+
  • Management of the same campaign/platform scope with media spend up to A$3,000 per month.
  • One scheduled account review each week, with appropriate optimisation within the agreed approval scope.
  • Up to two replacement copy variants and one existing image/video adaptation per month.
  • One report and a 30-minute review, including lead-quality feedback supplied by the client; no separate sales-call review or additional meeting.

The A$3,000 spend limit defines the service scope; it is not a required spend or a recommended budget for every business. Greater spend or complexity is requoted before work expands. Continuous monitoring is not included.

For scope counting, one platform means one advertising manager/account: Facebook and Instagram placements in one Meta campaign count as one platform; Google Search and YouTube require their own stated campaign scope, not automatic inclusion together. Platforms considered include Google Search, Microsoft Advertising for Bing, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn. Each requires its own fit and readiness checks. AI-assisted creative is reviewed before release.

Optional second platform: A$660 setup plus A$550/month for one additional offer/campaign on one additional platform, with the same setup and monthly creative quantity limits as the first platform. Its management allowance covers up to A$3,000/month in additional client-paid media spend, separately approved for that platform. No automatic budget pooling or increase. This is an add-on to the first-platform service, not a standalone full-service rate; reused creative is counted once and the quote identifies any additional production. Subject to fit, readiness and a separate written scope.

Extra costs: you own the advertising accounts and pay media spend, vendor tools and subscriptions directly with your own payment method. We do not hold your card details or collect media spend. Our agency management fees are separate. Additional campaigns, offers, locations, pages and specialist production are separate. Existing suitable assets are reused without duplicate production fees; new adaptations are identified in the quote.

Status: preparing. Account access/setup, creative approval, landing-page and conversion checks remain incomplete. No leads, sales or return on ad spend are guaranteed.

PACKAGE 03

Email and SMS Marketing

Keep in touch with subscribers and follow up people who have agreed to hear from you.

Discuss this option ↗
Setup A$1,320+
  • One sending platform and sender-domain configuration review, baseline delivery measures where available and agreed acceptance checks.
  • One signup/consent form and up to two segments.
  • Import up to 1,000 clean contacts after permission and source records are checked.
  • One reusable email template and a welcome sequence of three emails.
  • One optional SMS reminder step, with its purpose and consent agreed.
  • Unsubscribe/STOP, suppression, reply and failed-delivery configuration/tests. Required channel controls must be supported and verified before that channel is offered; an unsupported control is a launch blocker, not an omitted inclusion.
  • One source/booking connection through a suitable native connector.
  • Two consolidated setup revision rounds.

Poor-quality list remediation, custom integrations and additional sequences are separately scoped. Purchased/scraped lists and cold campaigns are excluded.

Monthly A$660+
  • One monthly campaign calendar and audience-exclusion check within the campaign preparation allowance.
  • Two email campaigns, up to 600 words each, with one subject-line alternative and up to two existing/simple branded images per email.
  • Up to two SMS copy/scheduling items, including approval and test preparation.
  • Maintenance of the original three-email welcome sequence, including one small copy/timing change; a new sequence is separate.
  • Consent, suppression and deliverability review, source-tagged links, one report and a 30-minute review.
  • One revision round per campaign, for a list of up to 1,000 active contacts.

Existing videos or VSLs can be linked from messages; producing them is separately priced. Email permission does not automatically cover SMS. Service reminders and marketing have distinct purposes and permissions. AI can assist drafts but does not independently choose recipients or send messages.

Extra costs: provider subscription, contact storage, email sends, SMS segments/credits, inbound charges, sender/number services and any extra migration or production. Two SMS campaign items do not mean two billable messages: charges depend on audience size and message length. Automated welcome emails also consume sending allowances.

Status: proposed; testing required. Sender configuration, actual consent records, delivery, replies, unsubscribe/STOP, failures and automation exits remain unverified. Sending either channel requires its relevant checks and approval.

PACKAGE 04

CRM and Customer Automation

Keep enquiries, ownership and next actions organised. Add chat or AI only where it fits.

Discuss this option ↗
Base setup A$2,640+
  • Up to five users.
  • One enquiry pipeline with agreed lead ownership and duplicate-handling rules supported by the selected CRM.
  • Three reminder automations with the necessary failure visibility, duplicate/stop controls and documented manual fallback. Assess the platform and effort before accepting the fixed scope; do not omit required controls to fit three business reminders. Additional business workflows and specialist data remediation are separate; included safeguards are not an automatic later surcharge.
  • An agreed routing/failure acceptance checklist and a baseline of available pipeline data.
  • One training session and written handover.
  • Fourteen days of post-handover support for delivered work.

We assess your CRM plan, access and current setup first. Licences, data migration, additional workflows and custom integrations are separate. This proposal uses the standard package fee. For new CRM offers, the setup price is A$2,640 with no CRM launch discount or discounted slot. Earlier CRM launch-discount tiers are superseded for new offers. Existing signed agreements remain unchanged. Separate Workflow Automation tier prices are unchanged; tax treatment must be confirmed before quotation.

Optional monthly care A$330+
  • One monthly check of the delivered pipeline and three automations, including agreed failure/duplicate checks; assess that this fits the total care allowance before acceptance.
  • Up to two hours total, including the monthly check, small corrections, assistance, minor changes and a summary.
  • Starts after the included 14-day support period; no overlapping support charge.

New pipelines/automations, migrations and custom integrations are separate. Continuous monitoring and 24/7 incident response are not included.

AUTOMATION

Workflow Automation and Integrations

Optional extension · preparing · platform testing required

Optional extension of CRM and Customer Automation, also available independently where your existing systems are suitable. We assess native automation and your current subscriptions before recommending Zapier, Make or n8n. You do not need all three.

Setup optionOne-off agency feeMaximum scope on one automation platform
Essential ConnectionA$6601 workflow, 2 business apps, 1 trigger, up to 3 action nodes and 1 decision condition
Connected OperationsA$1,320Up to 3 workflows, 3 apps, 9 action nodes total and 3 decision conditions total
Coordinated WorkflowsA$2,640Up to 5 workflows, 5 apps, 15 action nodes total and 5 decision conditions total

Agency fees are in AUD, including GST, subject to confirming tax treatment before quotation. One business/brand and one approval owner per engagement. These are alternative tiers. A workflow is one trigger-to-outcome process; separate triggers count separately. Supported connector actions, no-code transformations and lookups for the business outcome count as business-action nodes; separate branch actions count toward the total. Business routing uses the stated decision allowance. Required duplicate/failure/retry/stop controls are included in the fixed fee outside those business-node/decision counts, but may consume provider usage. App limits count distinct business systems, excluding the automation platform; extra accounts require explicit quotation. Vendor tasks, credits and executions are different usage measures, paid separately.

Each setup includes process/field mapping, supported connectors, duplicate and failure controls, synthetic tests, client UAT, a written handover/manual fallback and proposed 14-day delivered-work support. Essential includes one revision round and 30-minute handover; the other tiers include two rounds and 60-minute training. The coordinated tier adds an operator exercise. Plan, volume, access and capacity must fit before a fixed quote is accepted. No delivery date is promised here.

Optional care: Essential Care A$165/month for up to 1 workflow and 1 total hour; Operations Care A$330/month for up to 3 workflows and 2 total hours; Extended Care A$660/month for up to 5 workflows and 4 total hours. Each includes one monthly health check and usage/error summary within its total time; small adjustments use only remaining time. The required check/report must fit the allowance before care is accepted; no minimum adjustment time is guaranteed. No continuous monitoring or 24/7 response. Care is separately agreed, starts after included support and never duplicates existing CRM care for the same work.

Optional assessment: A$264 including GST for up to two total hours: one 45-minute meeting plus review/recommendations for one process and up to three app/plan checks. This is separate from the free introductory call and does not include a build. Custom integrations remain by written quote; A$132/hour applies only where agreed.

Existing CRM reminders, native website connections, messaging sequences and other purchased routing are counted once. These prices cover only incremental scope. No requirement to buy base CRM where the existing system is already suitable.

Extra costs: client-selected software plans, connector/API entitlements, hosting and metered usage are paid directly to vendors. Custom code/APIs, migrations, two-way conflict resolution, multiple automation platforms, self-host installation/administration, AI agents and customer sending/publishing/payment actions are excluded from the starting tiers and require separate scope and readiness checks.

Workflow booking terms — subject to written agreement

  • Setup and assessment payment amounts, stages and due dates will be agreed in the written quote before work starts. No deposit percentage or fixed payment split applies unless expressly agreed in writing. Work begins only after the agreed prerequisites and payment conditions are met.
  • Proposed acceptance: five business days to accept or identify unmet agreed cases; silence is not acceptance. Correct/retest in-scope defects. Included support is proposed for 14 calendar days from the day after written acceptance/handover and approved activation where applicable; record dates and preserve statutory rights.
  • Optional care is separately agreed after support, monthly in advance, payable within seven days, with no longer minimum term. Cancellation received before the next period prevents renewal; acknowledgement is confirmation, not a condition. Exact support channel/hours, dates and renewal arrangement must be agreed.
  • Proposed unused care time expires only if agreed and the agency was available; agency-caused non-delivery requires a reschedule, credit or refund. Reconcile completed agency work and refund unearned agency fees on cancellation, subject to applicable rights. Vendor bills/refunds stay directly with the vendor; no agency pass-through or deduction.
  • Written approval precedes scope changes, additional spend and live activation. Client owns accounts/data; handover, monitoring responsibilities, access removal, usage limits and data handling are documented. No blanket non-refundable deposit, deemed acceptance or automatic overage.

These workflow terms require professional review and express inclusion in your written agreement; publication is not acceptance or an override of other package terms. See our terms and notices.

Status: preparing; testing required on the selected platform and plan. These options do not expand the current CRM-first pilot or open paid bookings. Payment stages, acceptance, cancellations, recurring arrangements and support dates are draft choices requiring agreement and professional review before sale. Workflow Automation tier prices are unchanged; the no-discount CRM policy is separate. Full workflow terms are available in our terms and notices.

Separate scopes. No automatic add-ons.

Website care requires supported software, access and a provider that supports the agreed backup/recovery process. Backup storage, licences and hosting are extra. One hour is the total monthly care allowance, not an additional hour of fixes. Continuous monitoring, emergency recovery, malware remediation, unsupported systems and major upgrades are separate. If recovery testing is unsupported, resolve the dependency before accepting care; do not imply recovery was verified.

Status: all new add-ons are preparing; provider compatibility, permissions, workload, end-to-end delivery and cost controls require verification. No add-on is automatically activated, billed or represented as ready. These are agency-set draft prices, not market benchmarks or validated margins.

SHARED-SCOPE

Shared work is counted once.

One itemised scope. No duplicate production or care charges.

Before signing, one itemised scope assigns every asset, connection, reminder, report, meeting and care task to one fee line. Reusing a completed item is not a second build charge. A new adaptation or additional workflow is priced only after its incremental scope is agreed. Do not add the full automation tier or CRM base solely because another purchased package needs an already included native connection.

CRM care, automation care, chat/AI care and reputation/call-attribution checks must list their actual covered assets and total time. Shared checks, reports, communications and meetings are counted once; combined care is quoted for the incremental workload rather than automatically stacking every monthly fee. Setup-only work includes agreed handover responsibilities; ongoing agency operation is not implied.

Organic website corrections cover content/layout corrections. Website care covers supported maintenance and recovery checks. If the same fix belongs to both, allocate it once; neither replaces defect remedies for agreed delivered work. A paid assessment is not automatically required before every setup; reused discovery is removed from later scoped effort, and any assessment credit is explicit.

We assess your existing tools first and use them where they support the agreed scope. If another tool is needed, we explain suitable options and costs; you choose the provider and whether to subscribe. You subscribe in your own name and pay vendors, advertising platforms and software providers directly using your own payment method. We do not resell software, collect or pass through vendor charges, or ask for, receive or store your card details. Vendor prices, currency, taxes and payment-provider charges require a current quote; agency fees do not include them.

For illustration, one SMS campaign to 1,000 people using two billable segments per person consumes 2,000 outbound segments, before any other provider charges. Two emails to 1,000 contacts consume up to 2,000 sends, plus welcome/other automation emails. No fixed SMS or AI unit rate is promised here.

Third-party spending needs an agreed limit and approval. Extra service work is quoted first; there are no automatic overage charges. Final payment, cancellation and unused-allowance terms will be agreed before any paid booking.

PLATFORM-CHOICE

Your platforms. Your payment choices.

Client-owned accounts and direct vendor billing.

Salesforce is our primary CRM specialisation. ScalePlus, GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels and HubSpot are additional platforms under assessment; support depends on demonstrated capability, your plan and the agreed scope. Listing a platform is not a claim that its tests have passed or every feature is supported. Our own subscriptions and lifetime memberships are for our business and testing; they do not imply free client licences or permission to resell vendor services.

The same client-choice and direct-billing policy applies to organic marketing, paid advertising, email/SMS, CRM, chat, AI and optional services. You control vendor subscriptions, media budgets and renewals. Vendor cancellation does not automatically cancel our agreed agency service, and agency cancellation does not cancel a vendor subscription; responsibilities will be explicit in the written agreement.

You pay Hossain Consulting only its separately agreed agency fees through a payment provider named before payments open. Enter card details only in that provider's payment interface. We do not ask for, receive or store full card details; the provider may supply transaction references, payment status and limited billing information. We will describe the actual provider and information handling before accepting payments. Payment-provider implementation remains unverified.

OWNERSHIP

Your accounts. Your approvals.

Clear ownership, access and handover.

Your accounts, subscriptions, advertising assets and business data remain under your control. Client work takes place in your accounts, separate from our agency subscriptions and test environments. Invite only the access required for the agreed work; do not send passwords, tokens or card details. Enter your payment details directly with your chosen vendors; we do not enter or retain them for you.

Publishing, sending, campaign budgets and live changes follow agreed approval responsibilities. AI does not independently publish, send, change accounts or spend money. Human-managed availability and response expectations are explicit, not assumed.

You receive the agreed documentation, training and support. Access is removed after the support period unless further work is agreed. Fixes for agreed delivered-work defects are handled under the support/service terms, not silently classified as paid extras. We may earn a referral or affiliate commission if you subscribe through a recommended link. We disclose the relevant relationship in writing with the recommendation and in the service agreement before you choose. You can use your existing subscription, subscribe directly or choose another suitable provider. Our recommendation does not require a referral purchase.

PRACTICE

A new practice, with clear expectations

Hossain Consulting is led by Hemayet Hossain, a Sydney IT graduate with four Salesforce certifications. Current portfolio projects are self-directed simulations; we have no completed client engagements or client marketing results to present yet.

We distinguish working demonstrations from mock-ups and explain limitations. Reviews and case studies are optional, never a condition of fees or support, and need separate permission before publication. Rankings, lead numbers, sales and advertising returns are not guaranteed.

PROCESS

From first conversation to handover

  1. Discuss your business, current tools and one priority in a free 20-minute introductory call or by email.
  2. Check fit, service readiness, access and dependencies.
  3. Review a written scope with quantities, costs, timing, approvals and acceptance checks.
  4. Once available and agreed, build, test and review the work together.
  5. Receive the agreed handover and support; choose ongoing services separately.
BOOKING-TERMS

Before paid work starts

Terms and timing still need agreement.

Paid bookings remain closed while these terms and acceptance checks are unfinished. Your written proposal must confirm:

  • Setup payment stages and the date recurring services start.
  • Any minimum term, renewal and cancellation notice.
  • Whether unused monthly content or care allowances expire or carry forward.
  • Delivery milestones after access and materials are received; delivery dates require written agreement.
  • Approval turnaround, revision deadlines and how delayed feedback or paused work affects the schedule and billing. State revision rounds for paid-ad and CRM setup, standalone chat/AI and care add-ons where not already quantified; no unlimited revisions are implied.
  • Itemised agency fees and separately approved provider plans, media and usage budgets.
  • Written delivery/acceptance cases, who signs off and how in-scope defects are corrected/retested; silence is not acceptance or live approval.
  • Start/end dates for included support and optional care, support channel/hours, escalation and monitoring owner. No automatic recurring enrolment or overlapping charge for included support.
  • Fair handling of work already completed, unearned agency fees, delayed approvals, provider outages and client-caused changes; vendor payments/refunds remain directly with the vendor.
  • Ownership/licences for delivered copy, designs, configurations and pre-existing/stock/AI-assisted assets; permitted handover/export formats and any separately scoped transition work.
  • Data fields/purpose, necessary delegated access, approved processing locations/providers, execution-log redaction, retention/deletion and access removal. No credentials or customer records in public evidence.

These decisions remain pending review for the core packages, care add-ons and production extras; no default minimum term, payment schedule or cancellation rule is implied. The separate workflow section proposes specific terms for workflow engagements only. Do not treat those options as automatically accepted or extend them to every service. Confirm quote validity, billing-period definition, rate changes, expiry/rollover and dispute handling in the final agreement; preserve applicable rights and existing commitments.

FAQ

Questions before you book

Do you work outside NSW?

We currently serve businesses in New South Wales through online meetings.

Can you use existing systems?

Yes, subject to assessment. The proposal identifies what can be retained and any plan/access limitations.

Do I need every package?

No. Choose a suitable scope; shared assets and work are counted once.

How long will it take?

We agree a realistic schedule after reviewing requirements, access and materials. The prices are not a promise of immediate availability.

Are recurring fees compulsory?

Setup and monthly work are separate. CRM care is optional. Ongoing campaign/content management needs its agreed monthly service; responsibilities after setup-only work are documented at handover.

Can I book paid work now?

Introductory enquiries are open. Paid availability, payment arrangements and final terms will be confirmed before a paid booking.
